mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases above 0.5% and CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% annualized signal aggressive monetary tightening that raises real rates and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL inflation > 2.5%, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In housing market expansion regimes (HOUST > 1000k units), rising retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand that boosts corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST > 1000k and RSAFS rises, or Rank IC for regime-specific signal < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payrolls above 200,000 signals strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 200k, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month industrial production decline below 105 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 105 in 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts below 1000k and retail sales below 440,000 million dollars signal broad consumer demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue growth, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST < 1000k and RSAFS < 440,000, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening regimes (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), rising CPI inflation above 2.5% annualized compresses real rates and equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL inflation > 2.5%, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03.
